answer: Chi-square test of independence between m6A methylation status (Hyper/Hypo/no sig) and differential expression status (Up/Down/no-DEGs) in the bladder cancer dataset (row-level, n=12,754 from MeRIP_RNA_result.xlsx): chi2 = 901.45, dof = 4, p-value ≈ 8.10e-194 (exactly 8.100776e-194). m6A methylation status and differential expression status are strongly NOT independent.
